purpose: Locate the first R9/seed2026 divergence, then replay identical Guard injection points and diagnose LU conditioning. Diagnostic overhead is excluded from performance conclusions.
validation: 5000 original importance points (seed2026 xor0x5eed) +1094 existing peak-aware points, fixed across all phases
followup: Determine the first semantic candidate/matrix/pivot divergence, trace held-out error within that pass, dump the divergent local matrices for SVD. Replay baseline and candidate Guard points in both implementations, with self-replay negative controls. Preserve every outcome.
validity: Natural traced output must reproduce frozen uninstrumented ranks, error history, Guard counts, termination and held-out errors to roundoff; self replay must reproduce own natural trajectory. No accuracy threshold or stopping changes.

adaptive_followup.reason: Crossed Guard injection sequences swap complete final outputs. At pass2 baseline retains two old points whereas candidate retains none.
adaptive_followup.case: R9/seed2026, unchanged parameters; truncate the diagnostic run to two nominal sweeps only to inspect Guard residuals, not for an accuracy acceptance claim. Final cleanup may add local commits without a new Guard call.
adaptive_followup.measurement: Record actual random starts, known residuals and threshold with no extra random draws or numerical evaluations; compare the first two passes against full natural traces.

prefix_replay.purpose: Find whether replacing the first two or three Guard injection batches suffices; later batches are generated normally, with unchanged RNG and residual checks.
prefix_replay.validity: Retain all four outcomes, independently of whether they reproduce either full trajectory. These are artificial injection ablations, not acceptable production fixes.
